QuestInfo.name: Lost Blueprints
QuestInfo.0: You met #bChristopher#k, the excavator who is known for his terrible sense of direction, in #b#m102030100##k. He looks pretty grim. Find out why.
QuestInfo.1: Eliminate nearby monsters, and find Christopher's Lost Blueprints.
QuestInfo.2: Christopher thanked you for the Refreshing Sap, and for finding his Lost Blueprints. He said he'd find his way back to the Excavation Site on his own. Don't expect to see him again anytime soon.

0.0: Wait...no! I think I lost something when I dropped my sap bottle...
0.1: Oh, man! If Shuang finds out I lost 'em, I'm toast! You gotta help me out here. \r\n

yes.0: I lost the blueprints! The monsters around here must have snatched them up. Monsters like blue things, right? Ugh, why do blueprints have to be blue? Stupid monsters! Please, go eliminate Iron Hogs and retrieve my blueprints.

no.0: What? No, you CAN'T say no! Shuang's gonna destroy me if I return without them! Ohh...I can't perish...never to enjoy thick, sticky tree sap again...

yes.0: Awesome, you got my blueprints back! Now Shuang won't destroy me when I get to the excavation site! Speaking of which, I better get going. The excavation site is west, right? Near Henesys? Or is that near the Nautilus...

item.0: Where are my Lost Blueprints? Please, bring them back before I burn up in this heat!
